summary: Verified BBM sync-button UX fix. (1) After owner magic-link login opening Program for farm 'default', top-right sync button data-testid='silo-sync-button' renders in normal (non-red) state with text '🔄just now'. (2) After clearing cookies and reloading, the app's top-level toast 'Your session expired — redirecting to log in…' fires and user is redirected to /landing — which is the acceptable alternative behavior per the request. No silent failure observed.
